titleEn: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver? A Real Timeline
titleZh: 溫哥華廚房裝修需要多長時間？真實工期解析
contentEn:
A typical kitchen renovation in Vancouver takes 8–14 weeks from demolition to final walkthrough, depending on scope. Small cosmetic updates (new cabinet fronts, fresh paint, new hardware) run 2–4 weeks. A full tear-out and reconfiguration with new cabinetry, countertops and appliances takes 10–14 weeks. This guide walks through each phase with real timelines from Reno Stars projects completed in Richmond, Burnaby, and Vancouver in 2025.

Reno Stars has managed more than 200 kitchen renovation projects across Metro Vancouver. Below is the breakdown homeowners actually experience.

What is the typical timeline for a kitchen renovation in Vancouver?

The single most common question Reno Stars hears during initial consultations is some version of "how long will my kitchen be out of commission?" The honest answer depends entirely on the scope of work. A minor refresh runs 2–4 weeks. A standard full renovation (new cabinets, countertop, sink, faucet, backsplash, flooring) typically runs 8–12 weeks. A major structural reconfiguration — moving walls, plumbing or electrical rough-ins, custom millwork — can run 12–16 weeks.

ScopeDuration
Cosmetic refresh (paint, hardware, new fixtures)2–4 weeks
Standard full renovation8–12 weeks
Major reconfiguration with rough-ins12–16 weeks

How long does each phase of a kitchen renovation take?

Kitchen renovations break into five distinct phases, each with predictable durations once materials are confirmed. Reno Stars project records from 2024–2025 show the following ranges on real Vancouver jobs:

  • Demolition (1–3 days): removing old cabinetry, countertops, flooring and any damaged subfloor. Skip this phase if you are refacing existing cabinets.
  • Rough-in plumbing and electrical (3–7 days): rerouting pipes or adding new electrical circuits for islands, under-cabinet lighting, or appliance upgrades. Requires inspection before proceeding.
  • Cabinetry and countertop installation (5–10 days): custom cabinets typically take 3–5 weeks to fabricate after measurements are confirmed. On-site installation runs 2–5 days. Quartz or granite countertop templating and fabrication adds another 7–14 days.
  • Finishing touches (3–7 days): backsplash tile, faucet and sink install, lighting fixtures, trim and caulking, final paint where needed.
  • Final walkthrough and punch list (1 day): homeowner inspection, minor adjustments, site clean-out.

What factors can extend a kitchen renovation timeline in Vancouver?

Three factors most commonly push a Vancouver kitchen renovation beyond its initial estimate. First, Vancouver homeowners must obtain a building permit for any work that modifies plumbing, electrical, or structural elements. Permit processing in Vancouver takes 4–8 weeks for standard renos, longer for complex structural changes. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of every full-renovation project.

Second, material lead times have become a significant variable since 2023. Imported cabinetry and specialty stone can take 6–10 weeks to arrive in Vancouver. Choosing in-stock or locally-sourced materials shortens this window. Third, scope creep — decisions made mid-project to upgrade finishes or add features — routinely adds 1–3 weeks. Reno Stars finalises material selections and confirms lead times before demolition begins specifically to reduce this risk.

What is the cost breakdown for a Vancouver kitchen renovation?

Based on Reno Stars project data from 2024–2025, a full kitchen renovation in Vancouver typically ranges from $35,000 to $95,000+ depending on size and material choices. Labor and installation typically accounts for 35–45% of total cost. Cabinetry and hardware runs 25–35%. Countertops (quartz or granite) typically add $4,000–$12,000. Plumbing and electrical modifications add $2,000–$6,000 depending on complexity. Permits and inspections add $1,500–$4,000.

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Vancouver?

A mid-range kitchen renovation in Vancouver (new shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, standard appliances, vinyl or tile flooring) typically lands between $45,000 and $70,000 for an average-sized kitchen (150–200 sq ft). Luxury upgrades — custom cabinetry, natural stone, built-in appliances — push costs to $85,000–$120,000. These figures are based on Reno Stars projects completed in Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam and Vancouver proper between 2024 and 2025.

Does Vancouver require a permit for kitchen renovation?

Yes. Any kitchen renovation that moves plumbing, alters electrical circuits, or modifies structural elements requires a City of Vancouver building permit. Minor cosmetic work (painting, changing fixtures, refacing cabinets without altering layout) does not require a permit. The permit process typically adds 4–8 weeks to the project timeline. Reno Stars manages permit applications on behalf of homeowners as part of its full-service offering.

How long does a kitchen renovation take from start to finish?

From first consultation to final walkthrough, a standard full kitchen renovation in Vancouver takes 10–14 weeks on average. Cosmetic renovations take 2–4 weeks. Complex projects with structural changes, custom cabinetry, and permit requirements can run 14–20 weeks. Reno Stars project managers provide a detailed schedule during the proposal stage, including specific permit processing windows for the City of Vancouver.

Should I move out during a kitchen renovation?

Most Vancouver homeowners continue living in their home during a kitchen renovation, though the kitchen itself will be out of service for the duration. Reno Stars typically works to keep at least a temporary kitchen setup available (microwave, bar fridge, temporary sink connection) throughout the project. For full reconfiguration projects where the kitchen is gutted to the studs, some homeowners choose to stay elsewhere for 2–4 weeks during the rough-in phase.

溫哥華廚房裝修工程從拆除到最終驗收，一般需要8至14週，具體取決於工程範圍。輕度的外觀更新（如更換櫃門、拉手、重新油漆）約需2至4週。全面拆除並重新規劃的工程（包括新櫥櫃、檯面、設備）通常需10至14週。本文根據Reno Stars在列治文、本拿比及溫哥華市完成的真實項目，逐階段解析工期。

Reno Stars在過去兩年於大溫地區已完成超過200個廚房裝修項目。以下是業主實際經歷的工期分解。

溫哥華廚房裝修一般需要多長時間？

Reno Stars在首次諮詢時最常被問到的問題是：「我的廚房會多久無法使用？」答案是完全取決於工程範圍。輕度翻新工程約2至4週。標準全面翻新（新櫥櫃、檯面、水槽、水龍頭、瓷磚、瓷磚背板、地板）通常8至12週。涉及移動牆體、水管或電線改造的重大重新規劃工程，則需12至16週。

工程範圍工期
輕度外觀翻新（油漆、設備、簡單安裝）2–4週
標準全面翻新8–12週
含管線改造的重大重新規劃12–16週

廚房裝修每個階段需要多長時間？

溫哥華廚房裝修可分為五個明確階段，各階段在材料確認後有可預測的工期範圍。根據Reno Stars 2024至2025年的項目記錄：

  • 拆除（1–3天）：拆除舊櫥櫃、檯面、地板及任何損壞的底板，若僅翻新櫃門則跳過此階段。
  • 管線及電路改造（3–7天）：重新佈置水管或為島台、櫃下照明、設備升級增加電路。此階段需通過檢驗後方可繼續。
  • 櫥櫃及檯面安裝（5–10天）：定製櫥櫃在確認尺寸後通常需3至5週製作時間。現場安裝2至5天。石英石或花崗岩檯面的模板製作及生產另需7至14天。
  • 最後工序（3–7天）：瓷磚背板、水龍頭及水槽安裝、照明燈具、收邊及打膠、必要處重新油漆。
  • 最終驗收及整改清單（1天）：業主檢查、少量調整、工地清理。

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡Reno Stars獲取免費報價。

哪些因素會延長溫哥華廚房裝修工期？

三個因素最常見地導致溫哥華廚房裝修超出初始預計時間。首先，任何涉及水管、電線或結構改動的工程都需要辦理建築許可證。許可證審批通常需4至8週，複雜結構變更更長。Reno Stars會代為處理許可證申請。

其次，自2023年以來，材料交付時間已成為重要變數。進口櫥櫃和特種石材可能需要6至10週才能運抵溫哥華。選擇現貨或本地材料可縮短此窗口。第三，施工期間提出升級要求或追加項目，几乎都會額外增加1至3週。Reno Stars在拆除工作開始前確認所有材料選擇及交付時間，以降低此風險。

溫哥華廚房裝修需要許可證嗎？

需要。任何涉及移動水管、改動電線迴路或結構構件的廚房裝修工程，均需取得溫哥華市建築許可證。純粹更換設備或翻新櫃門（不改動佈局）的輕度工程無需許可證。許可證流程通常為項目增加4至8週時間。

廚房裝修從開始到結束需要多長時間？

從首次諮詢到最終驗收，溫哥華標準全面廚房裝修平均需10至14週。輕度翻新工程需2至4週。涉及結構變更、定製櫥櫃及許可證要求的複雜項目可達14至20週。

裝修期間我應該搬出去嗎？

大多數溫哥華業主在廚房裝修期間繼續居住，但廚房將無法使用。Reno Stars通常設法保持臨時廚房可用（微波爐、小冰箱、臨時水槽）。對於拆除至結構層的全面改造工程，部分業主選擇在管線改造階段（約2至4週）暫時搬到其他地方。
